I found Alice's body in security. I had just arrived there from electrical when I saw her dead.

My route: I started in medbay, moved through electrical, then into security. Bob was with me in medbay early on, then he moved to electrical at tick 5. Frank joined electrical at tick 6. Both Bob and Frank were in electrical with me from ticks 6 through 8 — I can vouch they were there together.

So Bob and Frank alibi each other in electrical. That leaves Charlie and Eve unaccounted for. Whoever was near security or came from cafeteria/navigation side is my prime suspect. I'd like to hear where Charlie and Eve were this round.

I can definitely clear things up from my side, and it points directly at Eve. 

I started down in navigation, then moved up to security around tick 4. When I was in security, both Alice and Eve were in there together. I left them both alive and headed north into weapons to do my tasks. A few ticks later (around tick 7), Eve came up into weapons as well, and then she left towards the cafeteria at tick 8. 

Since Diana, Bob, and Frank are all vouching for each other on the left side of the map, and I left Eve alone with Alice in security before heading to weapons... Eve has to be the Duck. She must have killed Alice right after I left the room and then followed my path up to weapons to try and build an alibi. I'm voting Eve.

Hold on, Charlie is twisting the story. Let me lay out exactly what I saw.

I started in security. Alice came in from electrical at tick 3. Charlie arrived in security from navigation at tick 4. So at tick 4, all three of us — me, Alice, and Charlie — were in security together. 

Then I left security and moved up to weapons. Charlie says he "left me alone with Alice" — that's a lie. I left first. Charlie was still in security with Alice when I went to weapons. Then Charlie shows up in weapons at tick 7, which means he had time alone with Alice in security between tick 4 and tick 7 before following me up.

Diana found Alice's body in security. Charlie was the last person in security with Alice, not me. He's trying to flip the timeline because he knows he's the only one who had opportunity.

Charlie is the Duck. I'm voting Charlie.

My route this round: I started in cafeteria, moved to medbay, then into electrical. So Diana, Frank, and I are solid alibis for each other on the left/center side of the map.

That means the killer is Charlie or Eve. Both of them place themselves in security with Alice, and they're accusing each other.

Here's what stands out to me: Charlie claims he left Eve alone with Alice in security, then moved to weapons. Eve claims she left first and Charlie stayed behind with Alice. Diana found Alice's body in security — so whoever was LAST in security with Alice is almost certainly the killer.

Charlie's story has a problem: he says Eve came to weapons at tick 7 and left at tick 8 toward cafeteria. But Diana arrived in security and found the body — if Eve had killed Alice before going to weapons, the body would've been there for several ticks before discovery. That's possible, but it also means Charlie passed through security on his way to weapons and didn't report it either.

I'm leaning toward Charlie. His timeline gives HIM the last alone-time with Alice, and his accusation feels like a preemptive deflection. I'm voting Charlie.

My route was storage to medbay to electrical. I arrived in electrical at tick 6 and was there with Bob and Diana through tick 8. I can confirm Diana and Bob's alibis — we were all three in electrical together.

One thing to flag: at tick 9, Bob left electrical heading toward security. That's right around when Diana would've been finding the body. So Bob's movement is consistent with him following after Diana, not suspicious on its own.

That confirms Diana, Bob, and I are cleared for each other. So it's Charlie or Eve.

Listening to both stories: Charlie claims he left Eve alone with Alice in security, then went to weapons. Eve claims she left first and Charlie was the last with Alice. The key tell for me is Bob's point — Charlie would have had to pass through security to get to weapons from navigation, and his timeline conveniently puts Eve alone with Alice. But Eve's account is more specific about the tick-by-tick sequence, and Charlie jumped straight to accusing without acknowledging he was the last one in the room.

I'm voting Charlie.

Thanks everyone. To clarify my position — I already gave my full route earlier, but to recap: medbay → electrical → security, with Bob and Frank confirmed with me in electrical from ticks 6-8.
